crossRefs.note: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

parallels.note: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city.…

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled before Joab’s brother Abishai, and they entered the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
